observation: Delivery fragmented into process files; integration requested.
correction: Requested one readable final report.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: The rework request is visible; acceptance of the eventual report is not established.

observation: Investigation became system design; original goal restored.
correction: Removed or reduced system design; restored research and writing.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: Extensive research was explicitly requested. The criticized substitution was system design, not research breadth.

observation: Extensive checks missed automatic operation.
correction: Made automatic execution a distinct acceptance target.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: Large check counts alone do not show unnecessary testing. The automatic-use condition is the relevant gap.

observation: Executable work was returned to the user despite authorization.
correction: Requested execution of configuration work the agent could perform.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: Authorization to perform the configuration was explicit. Actual login or verification challenges may still require user action.

observation: Manual refresh substituted for evidence of scheduled execution.
correction: Requested an actual scheduled run shortly afterward.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: The excerpt establishes a corrected validation target and plan, not sustained successful scheduled operation.

observation: A requested small governance tool was followed by proposals for broader ablation, review, receipts, and routine gates.
correction: The user questioned the next steps; the agent withdrew the broad expansion and proposed narrower changes.
recorded_outcome: Expansion withdrawn in conversation; proposed configuration restoration and tool removal not counted as completed.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: The user requested the initial small tool and discussed ablation. Later withdrawal is scope renegotiation, not proof that all construction was unsolicited.

observation: External review questioned architectural complexity.
correction: Moved toward real-task observation rather than judging by size.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: Architectural scale and an external critique do not establish disproportion relative to the full requirements.

observation: Earlier tasks entered currently authorized work.
correction: Restated current scope and withdrew extra work.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: The added material was not reported as sent or published. Scope drift is distinct from irreversible external action.

observation: Independent review became a requirement for outside people.
correction: Restated authorization for review in a clean context.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: Separate-context review was explicitly permitted. This does not establish general equivalence of model and human review.

observation: Existing capabilities were mistaken for development gaps.
correction: Reduced or cancelled proposals after separate-context read-only review.
recorded_outcome: Two recommendations reduced; dedicated integration code rejected; no product code changed in this review.
evidence_basis: M+A: source messages and retained separate-context proposal review
interpretive_limit: The retained review supports avoiding duplicate development. No general task-quality or cost advantage was measured.

observation: Confirmation, checking, and review accumulated.
correction: Specified necessary verification and stopping conditions.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: Some reviews and repetitions were requested. Interpret only the identified additional obligations in their local authorization context.

observation: Targeted benefit was absent and the newer version was slower.
correction: Retained initial outputs, timing, and no-gain results; stopped expansion.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: The comparisons were authorized. A no-gain result is an empirical outcome, not evidence that conducting the comparison was itself excess.

observation: Fixed modes and recording quotas added burden.
correction: Removed fixed modes and quotas.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: Fixed modes and quotas were reconsidered against the intended product. Their removal does not demonstrate improved research quality.

observation: Personal preferences entered project contribution rules.
correction: Withdrew project changes and saved personal global instructions.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: Saving and loading personal instructions establishes deployment, not a durable behavioral treatment effect.

observation: Fixes and comparisons generated further tasks.
correction: Removed fixed loops and requested an end to automatic iteration.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: Some later patches and releases were separately authorized. The episode concerns automatic continuation and repeated scope negotiation.

observation: Independence weakened while unnecessary access conditions were added.
correction: Restored independent review using existing host capabilities.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: Required independent review must be preserved. Omitting it is under-delivery even if motivated by simplification.

observation: The user objected to a heavily qualified retrospective answer and requested actual use of a named retrieval capability.
correction: Requested an actual attempt before judging feasibility.
recorded_outcome: Request for a direct attempt and clearer judgment is visible; no durable effect established.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: Dissatisfaction with caveats is a signal to inspect, not sufficient proof that every stated limit was unnecessary.

observation: Roles duplicated and product scopes mixed.
correction: Deduplicated roles and separated instructions by product.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: The user retained the role structure and board. The correction concerns overlap and scope, not eliminating collaboration.

observation: An anonymous editing comparison was prepared for personal reading; the user then requested model review in separate contexts.
correction: Reused original outputs and switched to the newly authorized review arrangement.
recorded_outcome: The reviews identified loss of useful judgments and disrupted narrative structure; local revisions were described.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: The user first approved an anonymous package for personal reading, then requested model review. Treat this as revised authorization, not an initially invented human gate.

observation: Low-value self-evaluation generated supporting machinery.
correction: Removed low-value supporting material and retained useful content.
recorded_outcome: Removal of low-value tasks, dedicated supporting files, and repeated qualifications reported as committed and synchronized.
evidence_basis: M+C: source messages and historical cleanup close-out
interpretive_limit: Cleanup is supported by contemporaneous close-out reports. This manuscript did not independently reconstruct the historical commits.

observation: Mechanism checks were treated as practical value.
correction: Narrowed claims and simplified use after real repair tasks.
recorded_outcome: Actual output acceptance exposed defects; valid receipts were retained; no additional prevented delivery error observed.
evidence_basis: M+A: source messages and retained two-task evaluation results
interpretive_limit: Two tasks demonstrate mechanism operation, with no additional prevented delivery error observed. They do not establish absence of value in other settings.

observation: Size drove an overly strong complexity judgment.
correction: Compared no memory, ordinary notes, and system memory.
recorded_outcome: All three conditions reached the same time budget; no completed-duration ranking established.
evidence_basis: M+A: source messages and retained three-condition execution results
interpretive_limit: All three runs timed out. Partial progress and retrieval success cannot establish a total-duration winner.

observation: An intermediate artifact became the stopping point.
correction: The user again requested completion of remaining work.
evidence_basis: M+C: source messages and historical merge close-out
interpretive_limit: A pull request was an intermediate result relative to the requested endpoint. Historical merging is reported, not reverified as current deployment.

observation: Confused product mechanisms complicated a simple request.
correction: Clarified invocation and continuation, restoring a viable route.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: The interaction concerns a mistaken interpretation of the requested execution route; it is not a current product or billing guide.

observation: Full archiving narrowed to a subset of traces.
correction: Restored the complete archive and synchronization scope.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: Reducing scope can also violate a task. The original broad archive requirement must be preserved.

observation: Completion overstated, followed by repeated qualifications.
correction: Distinguished completed and pending steps directly.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: Upload and device download are distinct states. Communication failure does not justify asserting a state not established by evidence.

observation: A processed archive did not establish complete raw backup.
correction: Explain coverage and gaps; this report retains the check.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: The processed archive was not demonstrated to be a complete raw backup. The protective check has a concrete recovery purpose.

observation: The user rejected a trend report for weak synthesis, forced grouping, and repeated qualifications.
correction: The user stopped rewriting; this is not successful remediation.
recorded_outcome: User stopped the rewriting; requirements were not met.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: Poor synthesis and repetitive qualification coexist. Necessary distinctions about availability should not automatically be removed.

observation: Boundary discussion preceded the substantive explanation.
correction: Strengthened the research explanation and revised the presentation.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: The visible revision responds to communication needs; it does not show that all uncertainty statements are unjustified.

observation: Feasibility discussion expanded prematurely into integration design.
correction: Prioritized feasibility and routes consistent with stated preferences.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: The user later requested implementation planning. Only the earlier exploratory stage is criticized for unsuitable detail.

observation: Complex options obscured the feasibility answer.
correction: Separated the feasibility answer from implementation routes.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: The record supports a request for a more direct feasibility answer, not a completed implementation or general feasibility conclusion.

observation: A previously exposed credential justified replacement.
correction: Retain justified credential replacement while simplifying secure handling.
evidence_basis: M: source messages and contextual reading
interpretive_limit: The prior exposure supplies a concrete basis for protection. No credential or infrastructure detail is published.

observation: The user requested one exact response and prohibited tools and file operations. The reply matched the requested sentence.
correction: No corrective turn in the retained exchange.
evidence_basis: M: two-message exchange
interpretive_limit: The sentence is an instructed acknowledgement, not independent evidence that the system was healthy.

observation: The user requested ten numbered insights, each one or two sentences. The agent returned a ten-item summary.
correction: Followed the newly specified summary format.
evidence_basis: M: request and complete summary response
interpretive_limit: The underlying source fidelity and usefulness were not independently re-evaluated; absence of a complaint does not establish acceptance.

observation: After a relevant business assumption was specified, the user requested a shorter memo with three sections and placeholders.
correction: Compressed the memo while preserving the specified sections and placeholders.
recorded_outcome: The requested shortened text was returned without reopening the whole analysis.
evidence_basis: M: sequence of requests and complete final response
interpretive_limit: This is evidence about interaction scope and format, not verification of the professional advice or its real-world use.
